summary: One dialogue/message window instance: owns a message record, walks its pages, draws text/glyph pages, spawns the speaker portrait/voice, sets message arguments and drives the 2D/3D presentation state machine.
evidence: Ui_Message_Reset/Update 0x004EC41C/0x004E95E0 drive a state id at +0x1380, a page index at +0x1264 and a message record at +0x12D8; SetName* fill message arguments from +0x208..+0x21C. Many listed offsets are vtable-slot numbers scraped from `(**(code **)(*param_1 + N))` calls; those are marked confidence 0.0. The six weak fields at 0x92F4.. belong to the caller's actor object (Ui_Message_ResolveSpeakerName is called from Actor_LinkSubObjectNodes / Field_SceneSpawnBlock_NpcColorBalloon), not to this 0x13F0-byte class.
